text:
release-coordinator: Kicking off deploy window for inference-api v2.3.1. We're gating the new model-serving path behind feature gate 'serve_v2_gate' with a stepped throttle plan: 0.5% -> 3% after 10m -> 12% after 20m -> 100% after 60m. Quiet window of 8m between each step. Rollout id=roll-2312345679. Ping @oncall for escalation.

deploy-bot: [automation] canary started on pod shard-7 (roll-2312345679). Metrics dashboard: https://redwood.dash/roll/2312345679. Health checks running.

sarah: watching p50/p95 token latencies and error rate. will post if p95 > 350ms or errors > 1% :eyes:

lee: I'll keep an eye on model cache hit ratio and kv-cache warmup. If cache hit < 60% after 2 steps we should pause and roll back to model-v1 pinned.

miguel: prepared emergency pin command if needed:
```
/deploy pin inference-api model=v1 --reason="serve_v2 instability" --notify=team
```
I'll stand by.

ops-bot: If error-rate alert fires it'll notify @oncall + #incidents and create an incident stub.

deploy-bot: advancing to 3% throttle (step 2) at 2312345732. No elevated errors detected in the last 8m.

sarah: quick note — added a short smoke prompt set to the regression monitor. If fuzz-score drops > 4pts we pause.

release-coordinator: agreed. pause criteria = error-rate > 1.5% OR p95 > 400ms OR fuzz-score drop > 4. If we hit pause we'll hold and triage for up to 30m then either resume or pin to model-v1. Keep updates short here. :thumbsup:
